text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

—The Japan Cup.
Though they had lost Agnes Tachyon,
the two of them had made it this far together.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Special Week... and
Silence Suzuka...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What the two of them each possessed was...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Special Week ate relentlessly,
channeling it all into sheer power...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Unlike me with my picky eating habits... That is
unmistakably... the true power of an Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka-san hid an extraordinary intensity within her.
An intensity that I lack...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Running styles and raw speed are just on the surface... The true source that sustains it lies much deeper...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So, where is today's rival, Zenno Rob Roy...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What could you be hiding,
Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...? My biggest strength?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Yes... I was hoping you could teach me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, that's true. There's nothing definitive I can point to, but if I had to say...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: An unbreakable heart, is it?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: An unbreakable heart...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In racing, things won't always go smoothly.
There are times when they don't.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I can't aim to be a hero if I just throw in the towel.
In every single race, I have to fight for the highest place I can...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I try to keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...
So that's Zenno Rob Roy-san's...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And perhaps... the final piece...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Cafe-san?
Are you saying you want to learn that from me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Learn... That might not be quite right.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
An unbreakable heart is likely... within me.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've forgotten it myself...
If only I could recall that feeling deep within me...

By pursuing her "friend,"
something is beginning to gather within Manhattan Cafe.

And this Japan Cup—
might just be the grand culmination of it all.
